definition: Neat and attractive enough to be shown to other people.
book: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
quote: Her shining copper sheathing, her galvanised iron-work, her deck, white as ivory, betrayed the pride taken by John Bunsby in making her presentable.
example_sentence: Give me five minutes to look presentable.
